n0e470852d8.headline: Measures Taken to Create Modern Greenhouse Farms in the Regions
n0e470852d8.summary: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev signed a decree to establish modern greenhouse farms in Uzbekistan's regions based on public-private partnerships.
n0e470852d8.why: This initiative aims to boost agricultural productivity and economic diversification in Uzbekistan.
